summary: Iteration 40 — Verified Playground, Cloud Console, Admin Enterprise Hosting, Developer Portal + 5-region backfill (sa-east). Backend pytest 7/7 pass (/app/backend/tests/test_iter40_hosting_regions.py): GET /api/os/state returns 5 regions including sa-east; GET /api/admin/hosting returns tenants[] with isolation/safety_profile{membrane,hinge,classifier,ethics}/evolution_policy/region_permissions/billing{cognition_cycles,tokens,keys,evolution_events,marketplace_items,wallet} + regions=[us-west,us-east,eu-central,ap-south,sa-east]; non-admin gets 403 on GET /api/admin/hosting and POST /api/admin/tenants/{id}/regions; POST admin/tenants/{doctester1}/regions {['us-west','eu-central']} → 200 ok + persists via GET; {['mars']} → 400; nonexistent id → 404. Frontend Playwright: /playground loads with playground-canvas + 5 seeded nodes (pg-node-1..5) + safety 100/100 + PERC/INTP/REAS/DECI/SAFE/ACTN bytecode; palette-add-P adds 6th node and drops score to 96/100 with orphan warning; cycle-run-btn animates trace ending 'cycle complete — output gate cleared'; cycle-step-btn present; clicking pg-node-1 then delete-node-btn removes node; mode-link-btn present. /console shows console-mesh-panel + region-map + autoscale-{5 regions} rows + console-failover-btn (click → status 'active — us-west degraded, N ticks to recovery') + console-cognition-panel (10 activation bars: percept/ctx/mem/plan/reason/safety/tools/mutate/evolve/out) + console-federation-panel (10 pairs incl sa-east) + console-deploy-panel with console-deploy-link → /marketplace/deploy + tick advances every 3s while live and stops after console-live-toggle (deploy panel footer text stable when paused). /developers/portal shows 'FrasbergOS Kernel v4' headline + devportal-quickstart code block + devportal-concepts (6 cards) + devportal-course (5 phase cards) + devportal-certification (6 cert-step-*) + devportal-cta + devportal-docs-link → /developers/docs + devportal-playground-link → /playground. Admin (admin@frasberg.com): /admin loads with admin-hosting-panel visible after AdminHosting import fix; 48 hosting-row-*; 5 region chips per row; clicking hosting-region-{doctester1_id}-sa-east toggles chip and shows toast 'doctester1@frasberg.com: regions → us-west, eu-central, sa-east'. Navbar Explore dropdown (click-to-open) exposes 'Cognition Playground' (a[href='/playground']), 'Cloud Console' (/console), 'Developer Portal' (/developers/portal) — all navigate. Regression: homepage, /os (cognition-graph + os-mesh-panel + 5 region-card-*), /marketplace (8 items), /marketplace/deploy (5 region buttons incl SA East) all load.
action_items: MINOR: The Explore navbar dropdown opens on click (not hover). If hover-open was intended, add onMouseEnter/hover trigger. Not blocking — click works reliably.

MINOR (test hooks): CloudConsole cognition activation bars and federation pairs render but do not have data-testid='cognition-bar-{key}' or 'federation-pair-{a-b}' attributes. Panel containers exist (console-cognition-panel, console-federation-panel) with visually 10 bars/10 pairs. Consider adding per-row test IDs for stronger test hooks.
critical_code_review_comments: FIX APPLIED: Admin.jsx was missing `import { AdminHosting } from '../components/site/AdminHosting';` — the main agent's own comment in the review request warned about this. Without the import, /admin would white-screen with 'AdminHosting is not defined'. I added the import (line 13). Please verify this is preserved.

Non-blocking: admin_hosting endpoint fans out over db.users, db.api_keys and db.marketplace with three sequential queries and O(users*keys) aggregation in Python — fine at current scale (~50 users) but could be replaced with a Mongo $lookup pipeline for growth.
Non-blocking: HOSTING_REGIONS list is duplicated between server.py and frasbergos.py REGION_SEED. Extract into a shared constant module.
Non-blocking: Playground/CloudConsole/DevPortal are large single-file page components (>500 lines each expected). Consider splitting palette/canvas/bytecode subcomponents.
Non-blocking: /admin, /os and /marketplace/regions pages emit /api/auth/me 401 polling noise for guests — expected but noisy in console.
